explanation: erdosproblems.com/49: Tao [Ta24d] proved |A| ≤ (1 + O((log log x)⁵/log x)) π(x), and (as his title and OEIS A365339 indicate) this holds even when φ is merely non-decreasing on A (Erdős' [Er95c] follow-up). The Lean statement uses g N (largest A ⊆ [1,N] with MonotoneOn φ) and gives C ≥ 0 with g(N) ≤ (1 + C (log log N)⁵/log N) π(N) for all N ≥ 10; since log log N > 0 there and g(N) ≤ N, the O-bound for large N extends to all N ≥ 10 by enlarging C. Faithful.
